# PaneUI

> React components you own and edit.

Install any item with `npx shadcn@latest add https://paneui.dev/r/<name>.json`, or add `"@paneui": "https://paneui.dev/r/{name}.json"` to `registries` in components.json and run `npx shadcn@latest add @paneui/<name>`.

- [Registry index](https://paneui.dev/r/registry.json)
- [Docs](https://paneui.dev/docs/)

Every docs page has a Markdown twin at the same path with `.md` (`/docs/button.md`); the links below point at them.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](https://paneui.dev/docs/index.md): React components you own and edit.
- [Installation](https://paneui.dev/docs/installation.md): Install the theme, then add components.
- [Theming](https://paneui.dev/docs/theming.md): Change the theme tokens.
- [Customize](https://paneui.dev/docs/colors.md): Choose an accent and corner radius.
- [CLI & registry](https://paneui.dev/docs/cli.md): Find, inspect and install components from the command line.
- [Design skill](https://paneui.dev/docs/skill.md): Design rules and checks for consistent interfaces.
- [Changelog](https://paneui.dev/docs/changelog.md): Updates to PaneUI.

## Foundations

- [Brand Icon](https://paneui.dev/docs/brand-icon.md): Shows brand logos. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/brand-icon.json
- [Icon Chip](https://paneui.dev/docs/icon-chip.md): Frames an icon so card and section headers match. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/icon-chip.json
- [Icons](https://paneui.dev/docs/icons.md): Rounded outline icon set used across the library. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/icons.json
- [Locale Provider](https://paneui.dev/docs/locale-provider.md): Sets the language of every built-in label. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/locale-provider.json
- [Theme](https://paneui.dev/docs/theme.md): Shared design tokens for every component. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/theme.json
- [Theme Accents](https://paneui.dev/docs/theme-accents.md): Switches the accent colour at runtime with one attribute. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/theme-accents.json
- [Theme Paper](https://paneui.dev/docs/theme-paper.md): Opt-in style with warm paper, serif titles and pill controls. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/theme-paper.json
- [Typeset](https://paneui.dev/docs/typeset.md): Styles long-form text in docs, articles and chat messages. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/typeset.json

## Forms

- [Accent Picker](https://paneui.dev/docs/accent-picker.md): Chooses and remembers an accent colour. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/accent-picker.json
- [Button](https://paneui.dev/docs/button.md): Triggers an action or submits a form. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/button.json
- [Button Group](https://paneui.dev/docs/button-group.md): Joins related buttons into one control. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/button-group.json
- [Button Stateful](https://paneui.dev/docs/button-stateful.md): Shows an action’s progress and result. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/button-stateful.json
- [Calendar](https://paneui.dev/docs/calendar.md): Month grid for picking a date or a range. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/calendar.json
- [Checkbox](https://paneui.dev/docs/checkbox.md): Toggles a single option on or off. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/checkbox.json
- [Color Picker](https://paneui.dev/docs/color-picker.md): Picks a colour by dragging, entering hex or choosing a preset. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/color-picker.json
- [Combobox](https://paneui.dev/docs/combobox.md): Picks one option from a long list by typing to filter. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/combobox.json
- [Date Picker](https://paneui.dev/docs/date-picker.md): Field that opens a calendar to pick one date. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/date-picker.json
- [Date Range Picker](https://paneui.dev/docs/date-range-picker.md): Picks a start and end date from a calendar. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/date-range-picker.json
- [Expandable Control](https://paneui.dev/docs/expandable-control.md): Button or chip that expands on click to reveal a label. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/expandable-control.json
- [Field](https://paneui.dev/docs/field.md): Connects form labels, controls and feedback. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/field.json
- [Input](https://paneui.dev/docs/input.md): Single-line text field. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/input.json
- [Input Group](https://paneui.dev/docs/input-group.md): Groups related controls inside an input. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/input-group.json
- [Input OTP](https://paneui.dev/docs/input-otp.md): Enters a one-time code, one character per slot. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/input-otp.json
- [iOS Zoom Lock](https://paneui.dev/docs/ios-zoom-lock.md): Stops iOS from zooming into small text fields on focus. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/ios-zoom-lock.json
- [Label](https://paneui.dev/docs/label.md): Names a form control. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/label.json
- [Multi Select](https://paneui.dev/docs/multi-select.md): Searchable picker for choosing several options at once. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/multi-select.json
- [Native Select](https://paneui.dev/docs/native-select.md): The browser's own select, styled as a field. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/native-select.json
- [Password Input](https://paneui.dev/docs/password-input.md): Password field with a button to show or hide it. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/password-input.json
- [Radio](https://paneui.dev/docs/radio.md): Picks exactly one option from a short list. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/radio.json
- [Range Slider Inline](https://paneui.dev/docs/range-slider-inline.md): Slider that shows its label and value on the track. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/range-slider-inline.json
- [Segmented Control](https://paneui.dev/docs/segmented-control.md): Switches a setting between a few options. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/segmented-control.json
- [Select](https://paneui.dev/docs/select.md): Picks one option from a list. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/select.json
- [Select Morph](https://paneui.dev/docs/select-morph.md): Select whose trigger unfolds into its option list. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/select-morph.json
- [Slider](https://paneui.dev/docs/slider.md): Picks a value or range by dragging. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/slider.json
- [Stepper](https://paneui.dev/docs/stepper.md): Adjusts a number up or down in fixed steps. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/stepper.json
- [Swatch Picker](https://paneui.dev/docs/swatch-picker.md): Picks one colour from a fixed palette. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/swatch-picker.json
- [Switch](https://paneui.dev/docs/switch.md): Turns a single setting on or off. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/switch.json
- [Textarea](https://paneui.dev/docs/textarea.md): A text field that grows with your writing. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/textarea.json
- [Toggle Group](https://paneui.dev/docs/toggle-group.md): Turns formatting or view options on and off. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/toggle-group.json
- [Wheel Picker](https://paneui.dev/docs/wheel-picker.md): Picks values with a scrolling wheel. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/wheel-picker.json

## Overlays

- [Alert Dialog](https://paneui.dev/docs/alert-dialog.md): Interrupts to confirm a destructive or important action. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/alert-dialog.json
- [Bottom Sheet](https://paneui.dev/docs/bottom-sheet.md): Opens a panel from the bottom of the page. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/bottom-sheet.json
- [Command](https://paneui.dev/docs/command.md): Searchable list of actions, inline or in a dialog. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/command.json
- [Context Menu](https://paneui.dev/docs/context-menu.md): Opens actions for an item on right-click or long-press. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/context-menu.json
- [Dialog](https://paneui.dev/docs/dialog.md): Asks for a decision or input in a modal window. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/dialog.json
- [Drawer](https://paneui.dev/docs/drawer.md): Side panel for navigation or secondary tasks over the page. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/drawer.json
- [Hover Card](https://paneui.dev/docs/hover-card.md): Previews a linked item while it is hovered. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/hover-card.json
- [Menu](https://paneui.dev/docs/menu.md): Dropdown of actions or options opened from a trigger. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/menu.json
- [Menu List](https://paneui.dev/docs/menu-list.md): Keyboard-driven option list that leaves focus in the text field. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/menu-list.json
- [Morphing Modal](https://paneui.dev/docs/morphing-modal.md): Dialog that moves between several views inside one panel. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/morphing-modal.json
- [Overflow Hint](https://paneui.dev/docs/overflow-hint.md): Shows the full text of a truncated label on hover. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/overflow-hint.json
- [Popover](https://paneui.dev/docs/popover.md): Floating panel for extra content or actions near a trigger. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/popover.json
- [Popover Morph](https://paneui.dev/docs/popover-morph.md): Popover that grows out of its trigger and folds back. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/popover-morph.json
- [Toast](https://paneui.dev/docs/toast.md): Shows brief notifications that dismiss themselves. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/toast.json
- [Tooltip](https://paneui.dev/docs/tooltip.md): Labels a control with a short hint on hover or focus. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/tooltip.json

## Display

- [Accordion](https://paneui.dev/docs/accordion.md): Opens sections of content on demand. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/accordion.json
- [Alert](https://paneui.dev/docs/alert.md): Shows a message that needs attention. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/alert.json
- [Aspect Ratio](https://paneui.dev/docs/aspect-ratio.md): Keeps content at a set ratio and animates ratio changes. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/aspect-ratio.json
- [Avatar](https://paneui.dev/docs/avatar.md): Shows a photo or initials. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/avatar.json
- [Avatar Generator](https://paneui.dev/docs/avatar-generator.md): Creates and edits avatars. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/avatar-generator.json
- [Badge](https://paneui.dev/docs/badge.md): Labels an item with a short status or category. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/badge.json
- [Card](https://paneui.dev/docs/card.md): Groups related content and actions on one surface. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/card.json
- [Carousel](https://paneui.dev/docs/carousel.md): Scrolls through slides one at a time. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/carousel.json
- [Collapsible](https://paneui.dev/docs/collapsible.md): Shows and hides a section of content. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/collapsible.json
- [Cover Art](https://paneui.dev/docs/cover-art.md): Cover images for posts and cards. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/cover-art.json
- [Empty State](https://paneui.dev/docs/empty-state.md): Explains an empty view and what to do next. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/empty-state.json
- [Kbd](https://paneui.dev/docs/kbd.md): Shows a keyboard key or shortcut. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/kbd.json
- [Loader](https://paneui.dev/docs/loader.md): Shows that something is loading. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/loader.json
- [OG Image](https://paneui.dev/docs/og-image.md): Creates page share images. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/og-image.json
- [Page Header](https://paneui.dev/docs/page-header.md): Title, context and actions at the top of an app page. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/page-header.json
- [Progress](https://paneui.dev/docs/progress.md): Shows how far a task has come. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/progress.json
- [Resizable](https://paneui.dev/docs/resizable.md): Split panes the user can resize or collapse. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/resizable.json
- [Scroll Area](https://paneui.dev/docs/scroll-area.md): Scroll container with thin scrollbars that stay inside its frame. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/scroll-area.json
- [Separator](https://paneui.dev/docs/separator.md): Divides groups of content with a hairline. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/separator.json
- [Settings Section](https://paneui.dev/docs/settings-section.md): Layout for grouped settings pages. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/settings-section.json
- [Skeleton](https://paneui.dev/docs/skeleton.md): Placeholder shape while content loads. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/skeleton.json
- [Stat Card](https://paneui.dev/docs/stat-card.md): Card for a key metric and how it changed. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/stat-card.json
- [Theme Toggle](https://paneui.dev/docs/theme-toggle.md): Switches the page between light and dark themes. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/theme-toggle.json
- [Timeline](https://paneui.dev/docs/timeline.md): Lists entries in time order along a line. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/timeline.json
- [Usage Meter](https://paneui.dev/docs/usage-meter.md): Shows how much of a quota has been used. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/usage-meter.json
- [Window Frame](https://paneui.dev/docs/window-frame.md): Frames a piece of UI as a desktop app window. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/window-frame.json

## Navigation

- [Animated Sidebar](https://paneui.dev/docs/animated-sidebar.md): App navigation sidebar that folds into an icon rail. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/animated-sidebar.json
- [App Shell](https://paneui.dev/docs/app-shell.md): App frame with a collapsible sidebar and an inset content panel. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/app-shell.json
- [Breadcrumb](https://paneui.dev/docs/breadcrumb.md): Shows where the current page sits in the site hierarchy. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/breadcrumb.json
- [File Tree](https://paneui.dev/docs/file-tree.md): Browses files and folders in a keyboard-navigable tree. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/file-tree.json
- [Icon Rail](https://paneui.dev/docs/icon-rail.md): Narrow bar of icon buttons for switching between app sections. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/icon-rail.json
- [Menubar](https://paneui.dev/docs/menubar.md): Row of menus for a desktop app window. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/menubar.json
- [Navigation Menu](https://paneui.dev/docs/navigation-menu.md): Site navigation with panels of links. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/navigation-menu.json
- [Outline](https://paneui.dev/docs/outline.md): Follows your reading position in the page outline. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/outline.json
- [Pagination](https://paneui.dev/docs/pagination.md): Moves through pages of results in a list or table. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/pagination.json
- [Preview Rail](https://paneui.dev/docs/preview-rail.md): Compact section navigation that previews each destination. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/preview-rail.json
- [Search Button](https://paneui.dev/docs/search-button.md): Opens search from a responsive toolbar button. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/search-button.json
- [Shared Layout Background](https://paneui.dev/docs/shared-layout-bg.md): Hover highlight that follows the pointer across a group. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/shared-layout-bg.json
- [Sidebar Nav](https://paneui.dev/docs/sidebar-nav.md): Compact text navigation for docs and settings sidebars. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/sidebar-nav.json
- [Tab Bar](https://paneui.dev/docs/tab-bar.md): Bottom navigation for phones, with a label under each icon. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/tab-bar.json
- [Tab Strip](https://paneui.dev/docs/tab-strip.md): Switches, closes and reorders document tabs. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/tab-strip.json
- [Tabs](https://paneui.dev/docs/tabs.md): Switches between related panels of content in one place. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/tabs.json
- [Toolbar](https://paneui.dev/docs/toolbar.md): Groups related actions into one keyboard-navigable bar. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/toolbar.json
- [User Menu](https://paneui.dev/docs/user-menu.md): Opens account actions for the signed-in user. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/user-menu.json
- [Workspace Switcher](https://paneui.dev/docs/workspace-switcher.md): Switches between workspaces or teams from the sidebar header. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/workspace-switcher.json

## Text

- [Action Swap Blur](https://paneui.dev/docs/action-swap-blur.md): Blurs between button states. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/action-swap-blur.json
- [Action Swap Roll](https://paneui.dev/docs/action-swap-roll.md): Rolls between button states. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/action-swap-roll.json
- [Animated Number](https://paneui.dev/docs/animated-number.md): Counts up to a number when it scrolls into view. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/animated-number.json
- [Code Block](https://paneui.dev/docs/code-block.md): Shows code highlighted at build time, alone or in tabs. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/code-block.json
- [Command Copy](https://paneui.dev/docs/command-copy.md): Shows a shell command with a button that copies it. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/command-copy.json
- [Digit Swap](https://paneui.dev/docs/digit-swap.md): Rolls only the digits that change. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/digit-swap.json
- [Marquee](https://paneui.dev/docs/marquee.md): Scrolls content past in an endless loop. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/marquee.json
- [Number Ticker](https://paneui.dev/docs/number-ticker.md): Number whose digits roll to each new value. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/number-ticker.json
- [Text Cascade](https://paneui.dev/docs/text-cascade.md): Rolls text letter by letter whenever its value changes. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/text-cascade.json
- [Text Reveal](https://paneui.dev/docs/text-reveal.md): Reveals a headline in sequence. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/text-reveal.json
- [Text Scramble](https://paneui.dev/docs/text-scramble.md): Scrambles text into its new value when it changes. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/text-scramble.json
- [Text Shimmer](https://paneui.dev/docs/text-shimmer.md): Highlights text while work is in progress. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/text-shimmer.json

## Motion

- [Magnetic](https://paneui.dev/docs/magnetic.md): Makes any element lean toward a nearby cursor. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/magnetic.json
- [Pull to Refresh](https://paneui.dev/docs/pull-to-refresh.md): Refreshes a scrolling list when the user pulls it down. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/pull-to-refresh.json
- [Scroll Progress](https://paneui.dev/docs/scroll-progress.md): Shows how far the reader has scrolled. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/scroll-progress.json
- [Scroll Reveal](https://paneui.dev/docs/scroll-reveal.md): Brings content into view as it scrolls onscreen. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/scroll-reveal.json
- [Scroll To](https://paneui.dev/docs/scroll-to.md): Button that scrolls to a section or position. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/scroll-to.json
- [Shader Background](https://paneui.dev/docs/shader-background.md): Animated backdrop for hero sections and empty states. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/shader-background.json
- [Smooth Scroll](https://paneui.dev/docs/smooth-scroll.md): Eases scrolling for a page or a scroll container. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/smooth-scroll.json
- [Sortable Stack](https://paneui.dev/docs/sortable-stack.md): List the user can reorder by dragging or keyboard. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/sortable-stack.json

## Data

- [Data Table](https://paneui.dev/docs/data-table.md): Browses, filters and acts on a set of rows. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/data-table.json
- [Simple Table](https://paneui.dev/docs/simple-table.md): A plain table for reference content like props and tokens. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/simple-table.json
- [Table](https://paneui.dev/docs/table.md): Shows large data sets that people sort, select and resize. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/table.json
- [Table Async](https://paneui.dev/docs/table-async.md): Loads table rows page by page as the reader scrolls. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/table-async.json
- [Table Editable](https://paneui.dev/docs/table-editable.md): Lets people edit cells and add or remove rows and columns. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/table-editable.json

## Agents

- [Agent Activity](https://paneui.dev/docs/agent-activity.md): Summarises an agent’s work. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/agent-activity.json
- [Agent Code Block](https://paneui.dev/docs/agent-code-block.md): Displays code from an agent, including code still streaming in. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/agent-code-block.json
- [Agent Progress](https://paneui.dev/docs/agent-progress.md): Shows how long an agent has been working. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/agent-progress.json
- [AI Sidebar](https://paneui.dev/docs/ai-sidebar.md): Navigates folders, projects and files in an AI workspace. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/ai-sidebar.json
- [Chat App](https://paneui.dev/docs/chat-app.md): Agent workspace with a sidebar, conversation and prompt bar. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/chat-app.json
- [Citations](https://paneui.dev/docs/citations.md): Links an answer's claims to the sources behind them. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/citations.json
- [Edited Files Card](https://paneui.dev/docs/edited-files-card.md): Reviews and undoes an agent’s file changes. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/edited-files-card.json
- [File Diff](https://paneui.dev/docs/file-diff.md): Shows one file's changes as a diff, even while streaming. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/file-diff.json
- [Image Generation](https://paneui.dev/docs/image-generation.md): Shows image generation progress and results. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/image-generation.json
- [Message](https://paneui.dev/docs/message.md): Lays out chat conversation rows by sender. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/message.json
- [Message Bubble](https://paneui.dev/docs/message-bubble.md): Holds one chat message in a speech bubble. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/message-bubble.json
- [Message Scroller](https://paneui.dev/docs/message-scroller.md): Follows new messages until the reader scrolls up. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/message-scroller.json
- [Model Picker](https://paneui.dev/docs/model-picker.md): Chooses an agent model. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/model-picker.json
- [Reasoning Text](https://paneui.dev/docs/reasoning-text.md): Status line that shows an agent is still working. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/reasoning-text.json
- [Streaming Response](https://paneui.dev/docs/streaming-response.md): Shows a reply as it arrives. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/streaming-response.json
- [Terminal](https://paneui.dev/docs/terminal.md): Runs a shell in the page or on your machine. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/terminal.json
- [Terminal View](https://paneui.dev/docs/terminal-view.md): Shows command output and takes commands in a terminal panel. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/terminal-view.json
- [Thread List Item](https://paneui.dev/docs/thread-list-item.md): Lists agent or chat threads in a sidebar. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/thread-list-item.json
- [Todo List](https://paneui.dev/docs/todo-list.md): Shows an agent's step-by-step plan and its progress. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/todo-list.json
- [Tool Approval](https://paneui.dev/docs/tool-approval.md): Asks the user to allow or deny an agent tool call. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/tool-approval.json
- [Tool Result](https://paneui.dev/docs/tool-result.md): Shows what an agent tool call ran and what it returned. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/tool-result.json
- [Work Summary](https://paneui.dev/docs/work-summary.md): Summarises the steps an agent took during one turn. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/work-summary.json

## Charts

- [Bar List](https://paneui.dev/docs/bar-list.md): Ranks items by a single measure. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/bar-list.json
- [Candlestick Chart](https://paneui.dev/docs/candlestick-chart.md): Charts price movement over time with volume. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/candlestick-chart.json
- [Chart Utils](https://paneui.dev/docs/chart-utils.md): Shared helpers for building and styling your own charts. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/chart-utils.json
- [Composition Chart](https://paneui.dev/docs/composition-chart.md): Charts how each part's share of a whole changes over time. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/composition-chart.json
- [Donut Chart](https://paneui.dev/docs/donut-chart.md): Shows how parts make up a whole as a ring. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/donut-chart.json
- [Funnel Chart](https://paneui.dev/docs/funnel-chart.md): Shows how much drops off at each step of a process. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/funnel-chart.json
- [Heat Calendar](https://paneui.dev/docs/heat-calendar.md): Shows daily activity on a calendar. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/heat-calendar.json
- [Sparkline](https://paneui.dev/docs/sparkline.md): Small inline chart that shows a trend. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/sparkline.json
- [Status Bar](https://paneui.dev/docs/status-bar.md): Shows a service's status history and uptime. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/status-bar.json
- [Treemap](https://paneui.dev/docs/treemap.md): Compares parts of a total as sized tiles. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/treemap.json
- [Trend Chart](https://paneui.dev/docs/trend-chart.md): Plots how values change over time. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/trend-chart.json

## Blocks

- [Agent Composer](https://paneui.dev/docs/agent-composer.md): Prompt input for coding agents with file mentions and commands. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/agent-composer.json
- [Approval Card](https://paneui.dev/docs/approval-card.md): Asks the user to approve or decline an agent's action. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/approval-card.json
- [Attachment Upload](https://paneui.dev/docs/attachment-upload.md): Adds attachments to a message or form. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/attachment-upload.json
- [Availability Scheduler](https://paneui.dev/docs/availability-scheduler.md): Edits weekly hours when someone is available. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/availability-scheduler.json
- [Card Folder](https://paneui.dev/docs/card-folder.md): Shows a saved payment card and reveals its details on request. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/card-folder.json
- [Chat](https://paneui.dev/docs/chat.md): Message thread between a user and an agent. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/chat.json
- [Command Palette](https://paneui.dev/docs/command-palette.md): Keyboard-first launcher for searching and running commands. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/command-palette.json
- [Email Editor](https://paneui.dev/docs/email-editor.md): Edits and exports email templates. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/email-editor.json
- [Expandable Action Bar](https://paneui.dev/docs/expandable-action-bar.md): Icon toolbar that reveals labels when the user reaches for it. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/expandable-action-bar.json
- [Expandable Tabs](https://paneui.dev/docs/expandable-tabs.md): Icon tab bar for switching panels in tight spaces. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/expandable-tabs.json
- [Feedback Widget](https://paneui.dev/docs/feedback-widget.md): Collects a short message and mood from users without leaving the page. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/feedback-widget.json
- [File Upload](https://paneui.dev/docs/file-upload.md): Upload queue for dropping files and tracking each one. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/file-upload.json
- [Morphing Search](https://paneui.dev/docs/morphing-search.md): Search field that opens into a list of results. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/morphing-search.json
- [Morphing Tabs](https://paneui.dev/docs/morphing-tabs.md): Reorders tabs and switches their content. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/morphing-tabs.json
- [Notification Stack](https://paneui.dev/docs/notification-stack.md): Groups notifications for review. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/notification-stack.json
- [Block Editor](https://paneui.dev/docs/notion-editor.md): Writes and saves documents. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/notion-editor.json
- [OTP Input](https://paneui.dev/docs/otp-input.md): Enters a one-time sign-in or verification code. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/otp-input.json
- [Overflow Actions](https://paneui.dev/docs/overflow-actions.md): Keeps secondary actions in a menu. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/overflow-actions.json
- [Project Folder](https://paneui.dev/docs/project-folder.md): Folder that previews its files and opens into a file view. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/project-folder.json
- [Prompt Bar](https://paneui.dev/docs/prompt-bar.md): Writes and sends prompts to an agent. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/prompt-bar.json
- [Recommendation Card](https://paneui.dev/docs/recommendation-card.md): Shows an agent's suggestion for the user to accept or swap. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/recommendation-card.json
- [Sign-up Form](https://paneui.dev/docs/signup-form.md): Account sign-up form with inline validation and password strength. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/signup-form.json
- [Swipeable List](https://paneui.dev/docs/swipeable-list.md): List rows with actions revealed by swiping, for touch screens. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/swipeable-list.json
- [Task Row](https://paneui.dev/docs/task-row.md): Shows the progress of one background task. JSON: https://paneui.dev/r/task-row.json
